name: Skibidi Toilet
blurb: A YouTube series of singing heads in toilets fighting camera-headed men, viral since 2023
title: Skibidi Toilet Meme: Meaning, Origin & What Skibidi Means
description: Skibidi Toilet is a YouTube series by DaFuq!?Boom! that began on 7 February 2023, with singing heads in toilets; "skibidi" became Gen Alpha slang.
answer: Skibidi Toilet is an animated YouTube series in which human heads pop out of toilets, sing a remix of "Give It to Me" and "Dom Dom Yes Yes", and wage war on humanoids with cameras, speakers and TVs for heads. Georgian animator Alexey Gerasimov posted the first 11-second clip on his channel DaFuq!?Boom! on 7 February 2023, and by late 2023 related videos had tens of billions of views. Its word "skibidi" became Gen Alpha slang and entered the Cambridge Dictionary in 2025.

body: The series is made in Source Filmmaker and has no dialogue. It started as short gag clips of a man's head rising out of a toilet and singing, then grew into a war story: the Skibidi Toilets against the Alliance of Cameramen, Speakermen and TV Men, with ever bigger titans and weapons. Episodes went from seconds to several minutes, and the series now runs to dozens of episodes over many seasons.

body.note: The theme is an unlicensed mashup of Timbaland's "Give It to Me" and Biser King's "Dom Dom Yes Yes", which is where "skibidi bop bop yes yes" comes from. In 2024 Universal Music Group filed copyright complaints and some videos were taken down.

head: Date
Event
rows: The first 11-second "skibidi toilet" video goes up on the DaFuq!?Boom! YouTube channel.
Related YouTube videos pass 65 billion views; the channel reaches 37 million subscribers in December.
Reports say Michael Bay and the rights holder Invisible Narratives are developing film and TV adaptations.
The Cambridge Dictionary adds "skibidi", defining it as a word that can mean "cool" or "bad" or nothing at all.
The YouTube channel is renamed "skibidi" as Invisible Narratives builds the franchise.

body: Outside the show, "skibidi" is a flexible filler word in Gen Alpha slang, often swapped into phrases for comic effect.

ul: "What the skibidi are you doing?" (the Cambridge Dictionary's own example)
"That's so skibidi" (could mean cool, weird or bad, depending on tone)
Kids singing "skibidi dop dop yes yes" in the playground
"Skibidi" stacked with other brainrot words such as Ohio, rizz and sigma in parody sentences

body: The series is still running and has become a franchise with games and merchandise, though its peak as a meme was 2023–2024. The word "skibidi" outlasted the hype as shorthand for brainrot humour. According to Wikipedia, in September 2026 Invisible named a new creative team and said Gerasimov is not currently involved in production.

faq.a: It has no fixed meaning. It comes from the show's song and can mean cool, bad or nothing, depending on how it is said.

faq.a: A mashup of Timbaland's "Give It to Me" and Biser King's "Dom Dom Yes Yes".
